title.narrative: Project for Enhancing Water Management Capacity for Responding to the Caspian Sea Level Decline

description.narrative: To tackle pressing environmental challenges, the project addresses the decline in Caspian Sea water levels by strengthening cooperation among the littoral states to enhance regional water governance. By fostering integrated transboundary data sharing, policy dialogue and joint action, the project promotes coordinated management of shared water resources across the Caspian basin. Central to this effort is the enhancement of Kazakhstan national monitoring capacities on the most affected northern region and inflows. This project will directly support the coherent implementation of Kazakhstan’s policy of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC), National Adaptation Plan (NAP), and National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (NBSAP), and contribute to the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
